problem: The live pricing page could render and pricing taps could respond while English switching still failed because the browser called /api/i18n-translate and Netlify returned 404.
root_cause: The live pricing page used critical inline JavaScript while production CSP enforces script-src 'self' without unsafe-inline, so the visible controls had no executable inline controller. A prior external rescue path also failed to provide a reliable ready marker. Separately, /api/i18n-translate was not explicitly routed to the existing Netlify function.
prevention: Critical pricing interactions must run from a self-hosted external script allowed by CSP, never inline JavaScript.
Use a new versioned asset URL when replacing the pricing runtime to prevent Safari/CDN stale-script reuse.
Netlify must explicitly route /api/i18n-translate to the i18n-translate function.
Website CI must execute real mobile pricing taps and actual English switching on an exact Netlify preview with Functions.
Do not weaken CSP with unsafe-inline to make interaction code work.
